physics_review.summary: The observed fitted-Rayleigh KS statistic is retained. The odd final-bin null is generated from the exact Gaussian linear coefficient process after mean removal and periodic Hann weighting; shifted coefficient-kernel dot products provide overlap covariance. The empirical odd final-bin mismatch is removed without changing neighboring bins. The independent DC/Nyquist nulls remain because fresh rates and saved common-null uncertainty do not show material miscalibration. For nfft=3 the demeaned periodic-Hann coefficient has Var(Im)/Var(Re)=9, violating the equal-variance condition for Rayleigh magnitudes; the existing ValueError guard remains.
